waypoints.name: Goodell Creek / Upper Goodell Group Camp trailhead (SR-20, Newhalem)
waypoints.note: Approach via Goodell Creek Trail and climber's path into Terror Basin (~7.4 mi, +5800'), then cross the Terror Glacier to the base of Inspiration Peak's south face.
waypoints.directions: Drive SR-20 east to Newhalem. Just after crossing Goodell Creek, take the first left onto a small road, turn immediately left at the T, and follow the road uphill to the Upper Goodell Creek Group Camp at about 600 ft; park there, and the climbers' path starts just down the road. Overnight stays in Terror Basin need a North Cascades backcountry permit, issued walk-up only at the Marblemount Wilderness Information Center.

waypoints.name: Inspiration Peak
waypoints.note: Route starts at the base of the south face, gains a col, then follows the exposed East Ridge — including a classic 5.9 hand crack — to the summit.
waypoints.directions: Follow the old Goodell Creek roadbed about 4 miles to a cairned flat near 1,600 ft, the last water, then climb the steep boot path to timberline and traverse to the 6,200-ft notch above Terror Basin camp. From camp cross slabs onto the Terror Glacier, rope up, and go east beneath the South Face past the West Ridge and South Face starts; cross the moat near its eastern end and climb broken gullies to the East Ridge crest and the summit.
